description: Welcome to this superb 95 sqm fully air-conditioned apartment with three bedrooms, ideal for up to 6 people, at the foot of the legendary Montmartre district.Immerse yourself in the authenticity of a real Parisian village with its cobbled streets, artists, lively cafés and exceptional views from the Sacré-Cœur. A bohemian and romantic atmosphere for an unforgettable experience in the heart of the capital!The spaceSituated Rue Etex, on the ground floor of a beautiful building in a quiet street at the foot of Montmartre, this flat enjoys a privileged location, just a few steps from the famous Montmartre cemetery.Decorated with taste and modernity, each space reflects the timeless elegance of the City of Light. The attention to detail is remarkable: refined parquet flooring, light colours and carefully selected furnishings all contribute to creating a warm, sophisticated atmosphere, guaranteeing a most enjoyable stay.As soon as you enter, you'll be seduced by the spacious, light-filled living room. Its sleek design and elegant furnishings make it a real place of conviviality. A comfortable sofa and connected TV provide the perfect space to relax after a day exploring the capital.The fully equipped and functional kitchen has everything you need to prepare delicious meals in a modern and harmonious setting.The apartment has three bedrooms, each with a Queen-size bed with a top-of-the-range mattress, plenty of storage space, a connected TV and an en suite bathroom.All three bathrooms are elegant and refined, with walk-in showers offering absolute comfort. One of them has a WC (2 in total in the apartment).For maximum comfort, this apartment is equipped with a washing machine-dryer, dishwasher, microwave, Nespresso coffee machine and air conditioning.
